notification.welcome: Welcome to **Pulse**! Go to the app settings to configure your API key and tracking preferences.

api_key.title: API Key
api_key.description: Your Anthropic API key for AI-powered summaries. You can find or create one at platform.claude.com.

model.title: Default Model
model.description: The Claude model to use for generating summaries.

sample_interval.title: Sample Interval (minutes)
sample_interval.description: How often measurement values (temperature, power, etc.) are sampled. Lower values capture more detail but use more storage.

retention_days.title: Retention (days)
retention_days.description: How many days of event data to keep. Older events are automatically deleted when a summary is generated.

excluded_capabilities.title: Excluded Capabilities
excluded_capabilities.description: Capability types to exclude from tracking. Use * as wildcard (e.g. speaker_*).
